scope: design literature review; no performance reproduction or novelty claim

references.title: Schefzik, Thorarinsdottir & Gneiting, Ensemble Copula Coupling
references.verified_scope: 원문§3.1/§4.2–4.3, reordering and unchanged marginal samples; ECC-R definitions.
references.difference_to_test: Use a learned conditional FM rank template for Tashu signed net flows; the rank-preservation result is not evidence of forecast/operational benefit.

references.title: Salinas et al., Low-rank Gaussian Copula Processes, NeurIPS2019
references.verified_scope: Original abstract and §2–4 low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance and marginal transforms.
references.difference_to_test: Mandatory conditional Gaussian dependence control; not a full reproduction of the original RNN model.

references.title: Scheuerer & Hamill, Variogram-Based Proper Scoring Rules
references.verified_scope: Original abstract and §2 equations3–4 and weighting discussion; dependence sensitivity and energy-score limitations.
references.difference_to_test: Use VS0.5 with historical-only pair/scale definitions, alongside region aggregate CRPS and joint-zero Brier; no one score certifies a full joint law.

references.title: Kollovieh et al., Flow Matching with Gaussian Process Priors, ICLR2025
references.verified_scope: Original abstract/problem statement and distinction of flow-time vs physical series time; univariate forecasting setting.
references.difference_to_test: Motivates examining structured conditional priors. Our graph/station covariance is a proposal, not a demonstrated multivariate extension of that paper.

references.title: Wei & Pearson, Flow Matching for Count Data, arXiv2026 preprint
references.verified_scope: Original abstract and §2.1–2.3 local birth/death rates, count bridge and approximate generation.
references.difference_to_test: Alternative for a future marginal-count-model hypothesis. Its latent birth/death path is not a measured bicycle rebalancing or physical-time simulator.

references.title: Lipman et al., Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
references.verified_scope: Original §3 conditional vector-field regression, also verified in H13.
references.difference_to_test: Conditional whole-supported-cohort rank templates, not separate station-wise rental/return heads.
